camel_example: aliyun actiontrail DescribeTrails --region cn-hangzhou --IncludeOrganizationTrail false --NameList 'abc,def' --IncludeShadowTrails false
description_zh: 查看已创建的跟踪列表
kebab_example: aliyun actiontrail describe-trails --include-shadow-trails false --name-list abc,def --include-organization-trail false --api-version 2020-07-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTrails

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the information about shadow trails. Valid values:

false: Do not return the information about shadow trails. It is the default value.

true: Return the information about shadow trails
parameters.help_zh:
是否显示影子跟踪，取值：

false（默认值）：不显示。
true：显示
parameters.name: include_shadow_trails

parameters.help_en: The names of the trails whose information you want to query. Separate multiple trail names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的跟踪名称列表。多个名称之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: name_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the information about multi-account trails. Valid values:

true

false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询多账号跟踪，取值：

true：查询多账号跟踪。
false（默认值）：查询单账号跟踪
parameters.name: include_organization_trail

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the trail was created

EventRW.description_en:
The read/write type of the events that are delivered. Valid values:

Write: write events. This is the default value.

Read: read events.

All: read and write events
EventRW.description_zh:
投递事件的读写类型，取值：

Write（默认值）：写类型。
Read：读类型。
All：读类型和写类型

HomeRegion.description_en: The home region of the trail

IsOrganizationTrail.description_en:
Indicates whether the trail is a multi-account trail. Valid values:

false (default)

true
IsOrganizationTrail.description_zh:
是否是多账号跟踪，取值：

false（默认值）：否。
true：是

MaxComputeProjectArn.description_en: The ARN of the MaxCompute project
MaxComputeProjectArn.description_zh: 跟踪投递的大数据计算服务项目的ARN

MaxComputeWriteRoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the role that is assumed by ActionTrail to deliver events to the MaxCompute project
MaxComputeWriteRoleArn.description_zh: 操作审计向大数据计算服务项目投递操作事件时，扮演的角色ARN

OrganizationId.description_en:
The ID of the resource directory.

This parameter is returned only when the trail is a multi-account trail
OrganizationId.description_zh:
资源目录ID。  

只有多账号跟踪返回该参数

OssBucketLocation.description_en: The region where the OSS bucket resides

OssBucketName.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket to which events are delivered

OssKeyPrefix.description_en: The prefix of the files that are stored in the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket
OssKeyPrefix.description_zh: OSS存储空间文件名的前缀

OssWriteRoleArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role that is assumed by ActionTrail to deliver events to the OSS bucket
OssWriteRoleArn.description_zh: 操作审计向对象存储OSS存储空间投递操作事件时，扮演的角色ARN

Region.description_en: The region where the trail resides

SlsProjectArn.description_en: The ARN of the Log Service project to which events are delivered
SlsProjectArn.description_zh: 跟踪投递的日志服务项目的ARN

SlsWriteRoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role that is assumed by ActionTrail to deliver events to the Log Service project
SlsWriteRoleArn.description_zh: 操作审计向日志服务项目投递操作事件时，扮演的角色ARN

StartLoggingTime.description_en: The time when the trail was last enabled
StartLoggingTime.description_zh: 最近一次开启跟踪的时间

Status.description_en:
The status of the trail. Valid values:

Disable: disabled.

Enable: enabled.

Fresh: The trail is created but is not enabled
Status.description_zh:
跟踪状态，取值：

Disable：停止。
Enable：开启。  
Fresh：已创建跟踪，但未开启

StopLoggingTime.description_en: The time when the trail was last disabled
StopLoggingTime.description_zh: 最近一次停止跟踪的时间

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the configurations of the trail were last updated
UpdateTime.description_zh: 跟踪配置最近一次更新的时间
